explanation: Frozen proxy updated completion counter and usage before the post-flight balance lookup, but logged completion afterward. A failed lookup could discard the result and omit its completion audit event. All benchmark execution failures remain unchanged. Recorded audit usage is therefore a partial total.
delivered_fix: Persist and audit paid result before balance refresh; preserve result on post-flight lookup failure; next paid call still requires fresh pre-flight balance. Fault-injection test included.
